summary: Tested creating jobs by hand and the 'Can create jobs' permission end to end (backend + UI). All 12 new backend tests pass, the regression suites pass (test_tab_visibility + test_job_scoping: 27 passed, 1 skipped), and every UI flow requested works: Yusuf and BD create jobs; empty title or client shows an error toast and creates nothing; BD's own chip is locked and she is added to assignees; Rupali gets no button and a 403 by default; turning the toggle on gives her the button after login; she can create a job assigned only to Ved and is still added; turning it off hides the button and brings back the 403. The only problems found are missing input checks on POST /api/jobs and a few code-quality items.

minor.issue: No input checks beyond title/client being non-empty. Verified: client='no_such_client', priority='bogus', due='not-a-date', assignees=['u_ghost'] were all accepted (200, job saved). Should check the client exists, the priority is one of low/medium/high/urgent, the due date is ISO, and the assignees are real users.

The id is max(existing)+1, so once the newest job is deleted its OS-0xx id is handed out again (seen: OS-019 was reused after deletion). Two creates at the same moment can also get the same id because there is no unique index or atomic counter.
All the fields are declared twice in the class body (copy-paste). Harmless at runtime but should be cleaned up.

issues: Due date uses the browser's native <input type=date> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere
Client and priority use native <select>s (they work, but don't match the shadcn style)
Toggles have no role='switch' or aria-checked (accessibility)
No toast when the job-creator toggle saves successfully (only rolls back on error). Acceptable, since the page says changes save instantly.

action_items: Add checks on JobCreate: client must exist, priority must be an allowed value, due must be an ISO date, unknown assignee ids rejected or dropped
Use an atomic counter (or a unique index on jobs.id plus retry) instead of max+1 for OS-0xx ids
Remove the duplicated fields in the JobCreate model
Optional: switch the New Job due-date field to the shadcn Calendar
critical_code_review_comments: _can_create_jobs: admins can always create unless they are viewing the app as another user. That is correct, but it relies on is_admin, while the Tab Visibility owner check relies on email. The two rules are consistent today but could drift apart.
On the frontend the locked chip is shown as selected for non-admins, but the locked user's id is not in f.assignees; the backend adds it. That works, but the payload and the UI disagree.
server.py is ~3000 lines and should be split into routers.
seed_data_creation: Created test jobs OS-019..OS-022 (API) and OS-019..OS-021 (UI), all titled TEST_*; each was deleted by its id. job_creators was $unset and tab_visibility.updated_at was restored to its original value. The DB now holds only OS-018, which was not touched.

Before testing, tab_visibility had no job_creators key, so the defaults apply (BD on, Rupali off). test_job_creation.py writes the ids it creates to /tmp/created_jobs.txt and puts Rupali's toggle back to off when it finishes; delete the created jobs by id afterwards.
